items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: And Gil Evans joined the band.

ctx.x: Did you continue writing for all the bands you—

Oh yeah. Then Claude of course was a great, great writer himself. And Gil Evans joined the band. But still Claude gave me a free hand, and he paid more money too. He was more appreciative of the effort that goes into making arrangements than Red.
You copied all the parts yourself?
